QuestInfo.name: Accessory Craftsman
QuestInfo.0: Grant wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: There's more to Accessory Crafting than you ever realized!
QuestInfo.2: Make crafting your passion in life!

0.msg: Oooooh! You've reached Lv. 10 in Accessory Crafting. Very good, very good!

1.msg: But there's more... Much more! If you think you are ready.

0.msg: Never be content with what you have. Always strive for more!

1.0: Ah, ah! You are here! You are here!

1.msg: Lv. 10 in Accessory Crafting is not the end. No, no! It is the beginning! After Lv. 10, there is Craftsman! Beyond that, there is Meister, which no one has yet reached. No one!

2.msg: To improve, #ryou must craft things near your level#k. Too high level or too low? No good, no good! Must be near your level.

3.msg: What is good to craft, you ask? I can see the question in your eyes. Accessories #bLv. 8 or higher#k is good. Accessories #bthat require recipes#k also good.

4.msg: With experience, a great Craftsman can make #bvaluable artifacts#k and #bimprove existing accessories#k!\nAlso, #byou can also grant a special power to an accessory.#k

5.msg: Pour your passion into your craft!

default.0: Not everyone is ready to reach the next stage, oh, no!
